SELECT q.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userName, q.monthly_token_limit AS monthlyTokenLimit, q.monthly_request_limit AS monthlyRequestLimit, q.used_tokens AS usedTokens, q.used_requests AS usedRequests, q.quota_reset_date AS quotaResetDate FROM ai_user_quota q LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON q.user_id = u.user_id
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY q.update_time DESC
